name: Aqara Smart Lock U100 (US)

radios.note: Aqara's spec sheet lists Bluetooth 5.0 and Zigbee 3.0, plus NFC for Home Key and cards. The lock itself has no Wi-Fi or Thread.

matter.note: No CSA listing for the lock itself was found. Aqara says Matter support needs a Matter-compatible Aqara hub, which bridges the lock.

apple_home.note: Aqara lists Apple Home support and Apple Home Key, which works by tapping an iPhone or Apple Watch on the lock's NFC reader.

google_home.note: Aqara's launch release says a Zigbee 3.0 Aqara hub is required for Alexa and Google Assistant support.

alexa.note: Aqara's launch release says a Zigbee 3.0 Aqara hub is required for Alexa and Google Assistant support.

smartthings.note: Aqara says Matter needs a Matter-compatible Aqara hub, but no official page names SmartThings for the U100.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant docs page for the U100 found. It may be reachable through an Aqara hub's Matter bridge, but that is not confirmed.

hubRequired.note: Aqara says the lock works out of the box over Bluetooth with the Aqara Home app, without a hub. Remote control, remote passcodes, Alexa, Google and Matter need an Aqara hub.

localControl.note: No Aqara source describes local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: American-standard deadbolt for a 60 or 70 mm (2 3/8 or 2 3/4 inch) backset and doors 35 to 55 mm thick.

keypad.note: Keypad on the lock, plus a fingerprint reader and NFC for Home Key and cards.

power.note: Four AA batteries, over 8 months at about 8 unlocks a day, per Aqara.

summary: Aqara's Smart Lock U100 is a US deadbolt replacement with a keypad, fingerprint reader and NFC for Apple Home Key. It works with Apple Home and, over Bluetooth, with the Aqara app without a hub; Alexa, Google Home, remote control and Matter need an Aqara hub. Four AA batteries power it.
caveats: Remote control, remote passcodes, Alexa, Google Home and Matter need an Aqara Zigbee 3.0 or Matter-compatible hub.
Fits a 2 3/8 or 2 3/4 inch backset and doors 35 to 55 mm thick; it does not fit euro-profile cylinder doors.
